thread:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Detected sudden 5xx/error-rate spike on route=embeddings-hot-route (us-east-1). Auto-playbook 'route-backpressure-v2' triggered. Paging on-call.
maria_qa: saw the alert, are customers affected yet? any visible errors from big tenants?
devon_oncall: logs show 500s from rseq handler, backlog in kv-cache flush. Error rate jumped ~18x over baseline about 03:39 UTC. Chat route latency creeping too from retries.
sahil_infra: I'm seeing queue length grow on pod set embeddings-hot-1/2/3. P50 p90 token latency up. Might be a downstream vector DB timing out causing backpressure.
jen_support: we have 2 incoming tickets from customer 'GlacierAI' saying embeddings calls failing with 500s.
devon_oncall: agree. Recommend immediate live mitigations: 1) apply per-endpoint quota throttle to embeddings-route to reduce concurrent requests; 2) enable route-specific fallback to embeddings-batch-slow; 3) shift some traffic to chat-safe-route to avoid overall capacity collapse.
sahil_infra: I can apply a temporary concurrency cap. Propose: embeddings-hot-route concurrent_limit from 600 -> 150 (25%), per-minute rate limit 1800 -> 600. Also add a burst_window=30s.
maria_qa: will that cause errors to surface to customers as rate-limited? want to avoid unhandled 500s; maybe prefer 429s so clients can retry gracefully.
ops-bot: [AUDIT] Applying change: route=embeddings-hot-route set {concurrency_limit:150, rps:600, burst_window:30s} by sahil_infra at 3918274200
ops-bot: [AUDIT] Routing rule updated: fallback_route=embeddings-batch-slow, max_retries=2
sahil_infra: done. I also changed the model-variant fallback policy to prefer quantized-embed-v2 for short requests to reduce GPU mem pressure.
devon_oncall: after throttle, error rate dropped ~70% within 30s. Latency P95 for chat stabilized. Embeddings success rate improving but throughput lower.
jen_support: notif to GlacierAI: "We’re applying a temporary throttling to embeddings to reduce systemic errors. Expect brief rate-limited responses; team is prioritizing retries." Will post status page note.
maria_qa: can we temporarily increase chat allocations to take spilled traffic? suggest chat-route pool +20% and raise its concurrency by 100.
sahil_infra: applying chat pool bump now. ops-bot: [AUDIT] chat-route pool scaled +100 concurrency at 3918274350 by sahil_infra
luca_platform: quick reminder: keep watch on billing spike if we reroute large embedding workloads to chat models — tag any tenant > 10k reqs/min.
devon_oncall: capture incident context in thread: root cause hypothesis = backpressure from downstream DB causing embedding inference to queue & overflow; mitigation = per-route throttle + fallback + pool reshuffle.
maria_qa: running a small synthetic load to validate fallbacks. will post results in 2m.
ops-bot: [METRIC] embeddings-hot-route 5xx -> 1.8% (was 8.2%) at 3918274460
maria_qa: synthetic run: fallback route returning results with ~200ms extra latency, no 500s. looks stable.
jen_support: updated status page: "Degraded — embeddings route experiencing elevated errors; temporary throttling in place. Working on mitigations."
devon_oncall: preparing handoff notes. I'll be on-call for another 12m then Luca will take over.
maria_qa: logs and query samples saved to incident bucket s3://redwood-incidents/3918274011/ for later postmortem.
ops-bot: [AUTOMATION] Set automatic rollback timer at +60m unless manually extended.
sahil_infra: leaving a couple of TODOs for handoff: 1) keep throttle until downstream DB patch or until 0.5% 5xx sustained; 2) monitor embed queue length; 3) coordinate with storage team if DB timeouts persist.
luca_platform: ACK. I'll take the on-call handoff in 12m. If we need to escalate, page storage leads and exec: @storage-lead @eng-sre.
devon_oncall: handoff: root cause hypothesis + mitigations applied + commands used. quick copy of actual curl used to change quota:

curl -X POST https://control-plane/redwood/v1/routes/embeddings-hot-route/config \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"concurrency_limit":150, "rps":600, "burst_window":30}'

maria_qa: thanks. will monitor logs and reach out if regressions.
luca_platform: taking over. I'll keep thread updated and either remove throttle gradually or escalate. Good work team :thumbsup:
jen_support: leaving note for CS to follow up with GlacierAI once stable.
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] mitigation actions applied. Incident assigned to luca_platform for monitoring and next steps."
